title: South Pontotoc girls win their closest game yet to reach 8–0
excerpt: The girls beat Mooreville 60–51. Mooreville won the boys game 47–20. Both South Pontotoc teams host Oxford on Dec. 1.
locality: South Pontotoc High School, Pontotoc County, Mississippi.

facts.statement: South Pontotoc’s girls had won each of their first seven basketball games by at least 20 points. Mooreville cut that margin to nine Tuesday, but the Cougars won 60–51 to reach 8–0. Mooreville won the boys game 47–20, leaving South Pontotoc’s boys at 4–4 heading into the Thanksgiving break.

paragraphs.text: South Pontotoc’s girls had won each of their first seven basketball games by at least 20 points. Mooreville cut that margin to nine Tuesday, but the Cougars won 60–51 to reach 8–0. Mooreville won the boys game 47–20, leaving South Pontotoc’s boys at 4–4 heading into the Thanksgiving break.

Mooreville scored more against the South Pontotoc girls than any team had this season. The previous high was Lafayette’s 42 in a 62–42 loss on Nov. 19. The Cougars also reversed the result from their last meeting with Mooreville, which had beaten them 58–43 on Feb. 16.

The South Pontotoc boys went into the week on a four-game winning streak. Alcorn Central ended it Monday, 48–41, and Mooreville held the Cougars to their fewest points of the season Tuesday. Their previous low was 36 in a Nov. 7 loss to Caledonia.

Both South Pontotoc teams return home Tuesday, Dec. 1, to face Oxford. The girls tip off at 6 p.m. and the boys follow at 7:30 p.m. East Webster then visits South Pontotoc on Friday, Dec. 4, with the same start times.
